picks.title: What I Learned Watching Six Hours of Gen-AI Short Films for the Reply AI Film Festival
picks.excerpt: An IndieWire juror reports back from six hours of AI-generated shorts at the Reply AI Film Festival — what the form can already do, and where it still falls apart.
picks.rationale: A juror's first-hand map of what generative shorts already nail and where they break — the most directly useful read this week for anyone budgeting AI into a cut.

picks.title: Here's a New Way to Easily Add Footsteps to Your Projects in Premiere or Resolve
picks.excerpt: Krotos brings its procedural foley footstep workflow directly into Premiere Pro and DaVinci Resolve, letting editors generate and tune footsteps in the timeline.
picks.rationale: Procedural foley that lands inside the NLE timeline — changes an editor's sound pass tomorrow, no round-trip required.

picks.title: Watch Wētā FX's VFX breakdown for season 3 of 'House of the Dragon'
picks.excerpt: Wētā FX released its shot-by-shot breakdown for 'House of the Dragon' season 3, covering the ship battle and the season's dragon work.
picks.rationale: Wētā opens the ship battle and dragon work shot by shot — the reference point for what a hand-built pipeline still buys you at the top end.

picks.title: Blender Studio Opens OVERGROWN's Free Behind-the-Scenes Archive
picks.excerpt: A limited-time Open Doors Week gives free access to OVERGROWN production logs covering animation, rigging, fur, shading, sets, lighting, water effects and compositing.
picks.rationale: A full production log — rigging, fur, water, comp — unlocked for free on a clock; a rare look inside a finished animated short's decisions.

picks.title: Avid's 20th Emmy and Adobe's first (for Premiere): the 2026 Engineering Emmy Awards
picks.excerpt: Scott Simmons unpacks what the 2026 Engineering, Science & Technology Emmy recipients say about the post-production tools editors actually rely on.
picks.rationale: Premiere's first Engineering Emmy alongside Avid's twentieth — an editor's read on which post tools the Academy now treats as infrastructure.
